create_LocalVisBackend: create a LocalVisBackend instance to save images, scalars, and configs to local disk
create_WandbVisBackend: create a WandbVisBackend instance to log images, scalars, and configs to Weights and Biases
create_TensorboardVisBackend: create a TensorboardVisBackend instance to write images, scalars, and configs to TensorBoard
create_MLflowVisBackend: create an MLflowVisBackend instance to log images, scalars, and configs to MLflow
create_ClearMLVisBackend: create a ClearMLVisBackend instance to report images, scalars, and configs to ClearML
